The main takeaway from our work is that

we have shown that a simple and non-invasive method of assessing myocardial lactate dehy-drogenase (LDH) subunit ratio (LDH-1/ LDH-2) can be used to assess the severity and prognosis of cardiac allograft rejection.

the lactate dehydrogenease ratio is a simple test that can be done on the same blood sample as the troponin I test and that it can help identify patients who are at higher risk of developing heart failure after cardiac transplant.
